$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the cmux.json keys cmux used to read and no longer does (cx-d5b5d). The daemon (cmux-config) embeds this file; scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift copy (SettingsSchema+RetiredKeys.generated.swift). Loading drops a retired key without a diagnostic, the schema export and Settings never list it, a write is refused as removed (reason shown), and a reset prunes it from an old file. Add an entry when a key is removed; never reuse a retired key for a new meaning.
